Welcome to IKEA, where you will always find affordable

If you are online furniture shopping or if you are visiting a local IKEA store near you, you can expect super low prices on a wide variety of exciting home essentials that are perfect for larger homes and small space living. So what are you waiting for? Refresh your home with affordable options for the living room, bed, bath and beyond today!

If you want to save even more money when you are shopping at IKEA, be sure to
join IKEA Family
so you can take advantage of our regular furniture sales, amazing deals on home furnishings and special offers on home accessories. Get ready for big savings whether you are refreshing your space with small upgrades, like new curtains or sheets, or planning bigger home renovation projects, like remodeling your kitchen or doing a DIY bathroom makeover!

Switching from fossil fuels to renewable energy is one of the most effective ways to limit global warming to 1.5°C. IKEA Store Facilities

The IKEA store offers a variety of facilities so that customers can enjoy shopping comfortably. We have IKEA restaurants and cafés where you can taste traditional Swedish food, as well as a play area where you can play for small children.​

There are a several ways to collect your package. Delivery at selected date/time, order online and collect at store, pick up at Pick Up Point with reducing delivery fee. Service fees can be found here.

Payment options

At IKEA, we think everyone deserves a well-designed, functional home – and that paying for it shouldn’t be difficult. That’s why we have multiple payment options for in-store and online shopping, including financial services for when you need a little extra help, which you’ll find on this link.

Return・Exchange・Cancellation​

You can return assembled furniture and used items within 365 days of purchase, provided certain conditions are met. We also offer guidance on exchanges for damaged items received and order cancellations.
See Return・Exchange・Cancellation
Spare parts

Find and order screws, cam locks, dowels and more for BILLY, HEMNES, POÄNG, MALM and other IKEA products. Get for free and delivered to your address in about ten days.

Assemble for you​

With IKEA assembly service, you decide how to spend your time. Because some days, assembling furniture is fun and fulfilling. Other days, not so much. Our professional, convenient service lets you get life sorted instead of sorting screws.

Buyback & Resell

With Buyback & Resell, you sell us used IKEA furniture you don’t need in a safe, streamlined way year-round. You’ll get IKEA credit. Someone else buys your old stuff second hand from us and gives it a new home. Everyone wins, especially the planet.

Life at Home Report 2021
Our fascination with life at home is what makes us IKEA. Every year, we ask thousands of people to share their thoughts and feelings about where they live. We want to learn what makes life at home better, so we can help people thrive there. It’s an ongoing research project that feels more important than ever.

A room-by-room guide for better balance
The #BetterHomeBalance guide is all about showing how you can use your home to better protect and nourish your mental wellbeing.
Our search for the secret to a balanced life at home
A balanced approach to mental well-being helps us get the most out of life, and we believe that starts at home. So, for this year’s IKEA Life at Home Report, we asked thousands of people around the world to tell us about their experiences.
5 ways to make your home the key to a balanced life
Many of the people we spoke to told us their homes are not currently meeting their needs. So, we shared the report findings with two of our IKEA experts and asked them for their tips on achieving balance in five key areas of home life.
The surprising statistics behind Life at Home Report in 2021
To better understand how habits and routines have changed, we’ve compiled some of the most interesting statistics around life at home in 2021.
More about our research
Methods

Our annual Life at Home Report is one of the most comprehensive research projects of its kind in the world. We ask thousands of people to open up about their needs and dreams. We follow individual families for months at a time. We consult with experts and carry out extensive desk research. Our aim is to reach a better understanding of what life at home means for all of us.
Explore the IKEA Life at Home Report
Dimensions of home

Most of us describe our home by talking about the people we live with, the things we own, the amount of space we have, and the place where we live. These four dimensions – relationships, things, space, place – help us explain how our homes are organised and what kinds of activities we usually do there. They reveal how much we have in common, even when each home can look and feel very different.
Emotional needs of home

Home is more than a place – it’s a feeling. Through our research, we aim to find out what people really mean when they talk about the ‘feeling of home’. So far, we have identified five core emotional needs connected to life at home: privacy, security, comfort, ownership and belonging. When we have all these needs met, we are more likely to feel at home.

How can you make your own healthy, happy home?

In today’s world, mental and physical wellbeing are essential pillars of a happy, fulfilling and healthy home life. But what do 'wellbeing’ and a ‘healthy home’ really mean? The answer is, of course, personal. From 10,000 steps and plant-rich diets to 30-minute rests and plant-rich rooms – it’s all about individual preferences and choices. And the simple, affordable changes we can make to help us feel authentically good.

It’s all about the small moments that bring a touch of magic into the everyday.

How can you put your ‘self’ into your space?

Our research has taught us that when we feel ourselves at home, we enjoy our homes more. At a time when the world feels increasingly unpredictable, expensive to live in, obsessed with looks and actions, can our homes become the haven for us to simply ‘be’? Finding and building our own ‘vibe’ is about giving our spaces the freedom to be as unique as we are, and finding the joy in making small but meaningful improvements.

What ways can you find to share quality time?

Moments of human connection help make us tick, they help the days go by. Whether through shared meals, laughter, or connections with ourselves and loved ones at home, embracing simple rituals and nurturing community bonds can make home life more fulfilling. Through technology we can also achieve the same kind of connections at a distance. It’s all about finding those everyday moments of warmth and connection, and simple ways to make it happen.

Dubai:

Dubai is home to two major IKEA stores, each strategically located for maximum convenience.

IKEA Dubai Festival City
, located at Festival City Mall, caters to Old Dubai, Downtown, and Business Bay residents.

IKEA Jebel Ali
, located at Festival Plaza mall that makes it easily accessible to both residents of New Dubai and Abu Dhabi.

Among these, IKEA Jebel Ali stands out as the largest store, featuring the widest collection of items, from stylish furniture to design studios and home planning services. The store offers everything you need to revamp your home. Moreover, you can even enjoy the Småland Kids’ Play Area to keep your little ones entertained while you shop. You can also keep an eye on a packed schedule of in-store activities for your kids! For added convenience, both stores now offer a self-service assembly area, where you can put together your furniture for FREE.
Abu Dhabi:

The stores in Abu Dhabi reflect the same sustainable features and customer-first approach as the rest of the UAE making sure you find all that you are looking for in your Home. These stores also feature larger play areas for kids, ensuring a smooth shopping experience for families.

IKEA Abu Dhabi YAS Island
is recognized as the most sustainable store in the UAE, making it an eco-friendly destination for home shoppers.

IKEA Al Wahda
: Visit the IKEA Al Wahda store and benefit from planning and consultation services. After a long, exhausting shopping experience, pass by the Swedish restaurant, bistro, and Swedish food market for a break. To make commuting easier, you can also arrive at the Al Wahda store via the Al Wahda bus stop.

IKEA Dalma Mall
: A full-size IKEA store located in Abu Dhabi. Offers a complete IKEA shopping experience including furniture, home accessories, a Swedish restaurant, Bistro, and a Swedish food market.

Al Ain:

As the only IKEA store in Al Ain, we’re here to offer a go-to destination for stylish, affordable home furniture. Located inside Al Jimi Mall, our newly expanded full-size store is now five times larger, creating a more spacious and inspiring environment where you can explore ideas, discover solutions, and create a home that reflects your unique style.

IKEA Al Ain - Jimi mall

Al-Fujairah:

IKEA Al-Fujairah
, located in City Centre Fujairah mall, is unique as the only IKEA in Fujairah. Though smaller in size, this store provides a curated selection of best-selling furniture, home furnishing advice, and order-and-collect services, making it a convenient option for residents in the region.

Join the Fun: Daily Kids Activities at IKEA

At IKEA, we believe in creating spaces where the whole family can come together, and that includes making sure our youngest visitors have a fantastic time. That’s why we’re excited to introduce our daily kids' activities, designed to spark creativity, inspire learning, and most importantly, bring a smile to your child’s face.
A World of Discovery Every Day

Each day at IKEA, we offer a new adventure for kids to explore. Our activities range from hands-on crafts and DIY projects to interactive storytelling sessions, all led by our friendly and experienced staff. Whether your child loves to paint, build, or imagine new worlds, there’s something special waiting for them every day.

Our crafts are designed to be easy to follow, so even the littlest hands can join in the fun. From creating colorful masterpieces to assembling their very own mini furniture pieces, your child will enjoy hours of creative play. Plus, all the materials used in our activities are safe and environmentally friendly, so you can feel good about their participation.
Learn While Having Fun

At IKEA, we know that play is an important part of a child’s development. That’s why our activities are not only fun but also educational. Through creative play, kids can develop important skills like problem-solving, hand-eye coordination, and social interaction. Our daily activities are designed to engage their minds and help them learn in a way that feels like play.

Each session is tailored to different age groups, ensuring that every child has an experience that’s just right for them. Whether they’re learning to count with colorful beads, exploring shapes with building blocks, or getting crafty with our eco-friendly materials, there’s always something new to discover.
Join Us Today!

We invite you to bring your children along on your next visit to IKEA and let them explore the joy of creativity with our daily kids' activities. It’s the perfect opportunity for them to learn, play, and make new friends while you shop for your home. We can’t wait to see you and your family soon!

Keeping safety in mind at home
Most accidents that injure people occur in and around the home – and, often, they’re easily preventable. The way you use the furniture and home accessories that you live with can play a major role in your family’s safety.
Around the home, where do most accidents happen?
Living room
35%
Kitchen
17%
Garden
9%
Families spend the most time together in the living room, so injuries are more likely there.

Source: EuroSafe IKEA-specific analysis based on European Injury Statistics Database, from 2008-2018.

What are some of the most common hazards at home?

Falls and slips, for example over rugs, on wet floors or during play.

Accidental ingestion of chemicals or medicines that can cause poisoning.

Furniture tip-overs can cause, for example, crushing injuries or suffocation.

Cords of window blinds, which can lead to strangulation.

Any small object that a child can pick up, swallow and choke on.

Candles, matches and cooking appliances can all be a fire risk if left unattended.

Even very little water can be enough for small babies to drown quickly.

Hot food and drinks can scald or burn.

Keeping safety in mind at home
Most accidents that injure people occur in and around the home – and, often, they’re easily preventable. The way you use the furniture and home accessories that you live with can play a major role in your family’s safety.

Around the home, where do most accidents happen?

Families spend the most time together in the living room, so injuries are more likely there. Other common spaces for accidents are the kitchens and gardens.
What is IKEA safer life at home?

At IKEA we believe everyone has the right to feel safe at home. Unfortunately, that’s not always the case. Every year, too many people get injured in their own homes.

That’s why we want to do what we can to change that – and make home a safer place for everyone. A continuous effort based on what we stand for. We call it IKEA safer life at home.

What are some of the most common hazards at home?

Falls and slips, for example over rugs, on wet floors or during play.

Accidental ingestion of chemicals or medicines that can cause poisoning.

Cords of window blinds, which can lead to strangulation.

Any small object that a child can pick up, swallow and choke on.

Candles, matches and cooking appliances can all be a fire risk if left unattended.

Even very little water can be enough for small babies to drown quickly.

Hot food and drinks can scald or burn.

Raise a Concern: IKEA supply chain
The workplace should always be a safe place

The IKEA business is based on honesty, respect, fairness, and integrity. Our IWAY code of conduct and our suppliers guide responsible decisions across the value chain. Still, breaches can happen. That’s why IKEA suppliers are expected to have safe, retaliation-free processes for reporting concerns. If those processes don’t work, IKEA provides a Raise a Concern platform, as a last resort.
Raise a concern regarding the IKEA supply chain
Raising concerns helps solve problems, take action, and improve. Staying silent can make things worse and create distrust. If you observe or experience misconduct, such as IWAY breaches, anywhere in the IKEA supply chain:
First, speak to a manager in the supplier organisation where the situation occurs, or use their reporting process.
If that’s not possible, use the IKEA Raise a Concern platform as a last resort, which can be found below.

I want to raise a concern
Procedure in your language
IWAY, our supplier code of conduct

Our suppliers and value chain are fundamental to achieving our ambition and making a positive difference. This is why at IKEA we have IWAY, our supplier code of conduct. It is an enabler for two IKEA strategies, the Sustainability and Supply strategies, and it sets out a common commitment to social and environmental responsibility in our value chain. IWAY describes requirements that we expect our suppliers to fulfil, as well as accompanying ways of working for IKEA organisations.
Learn more about IWAY
Frequently asked questions
Why should I raise a concern?
Raising concerns is key to sustaining a safe and secure work environment. We hope you see it as your responsibility to raise your concern and feel safe to do so. Remaining silent could make the situation worse. When you raise your concern, we can improve together.
How do I raise a concern?
We believe that supply chain-related concerns can best be handled by the supplier organisation where they arise. However, if the reporting process within the supplier organisation isn’t sufficient, we offer the Raise a Concern platform as a last resort.
Who can raise a concern?
Anyone who sees or experiences breaches of the IKEA supplier code of conduct (IWAY), laws or regulations. You can raise a concern anonymously, unless applicable laws in your country don’t allow anonymous reporting. If you do include your name, we’ll make every effort to ensure that your identity remains protected.
What types of concerns can I raise?
You can raise concerns about potential wrongdoings by supplier organisations, for example, breaches of IWAY, the IKEA supplier code of conduct and/or breaches of applicable laws and regulations. Broadly speaking, you’re encouraged to report situations where an IKEA supplier abuses the environment, human rights or labour rights.
What happens after I have raised a concern?
Inter IKEA Group takes all reported concerns seriously and evaluates them in a careful, objective and fair manner. You will be updated throughout the process.
How do you secure that my concern is confidential?
Every effort will be made not to reveal your identity. All reported concerns are treated and labelled as strictly confidential, including the identities of the reporter(s) and anyone mentioned in the report. Information will only be shared with a small group of people on a strictly need-to-know basis. Only if required by law, information will be provided to third parties, like governmental bodies.

IKEA Family club benefits. Get more from your membership!

Free coffee or tea on weekdays

We like to treat our members like family. So, next time you visit the store any day from Monday to Friday, let’s make you feel at home with a free coffee or tea. All you need to do is spend 1 € or more with your IKEA Family card at the Swedish restaurant and exchange your receipt for one mug to pour in the hot drink of your choice.

Special offers every month

As a member you deserve more. This is why you always get special prices on the IKEA range. A list of special offers is updated once a month. To see what offers are available, simply look for blue price labels in the store and online or subscribe to IKEA newsletters and get notified about them via email.

365-day return policy

Show your IKEA Family card at the check-out, and you will be able to return new and unopened products within 365 days for a full refund in case you’re not totally satisfied with your purchase.

Regular news and inspiration

Join the IKEA Family club and agree to direct marketing when registering. This way you will regularly receive our inspirational newsletters with product news, special offers, and ideas for home. You can also subscribe to newsletters at any time by logging in to your account.

Being first at the pre-sale

We announce a sale twice a year: in the summer and in the winter. As an IKEA Family member, you can check and purchase all pre-sale offers one day earlier than others. Since the amount of goods is usually limited, this means you can get your desired products at special sale prices before they’re out of stock.

+30 min. at the “Småland” play area

Show your IKEA Family card and your child‘s playing session at the Småland children‘s play area will be extended by 30 minutes. This means your child can have more fun while you get to shop in peace.

Free insurance of goods

Things don’t always go to plan. When they don’t, it’s nice to know that you are in safe hands. Show your IKEA Family card when paying at physical selling points, or be logged in to your IKEA Family account when ordering products online for pick-up. This will insure your new products against any accidental damage on the way home. If you break it, we replace it within 90 days from the date of purchase.

1. What is the IKEA Family program?

IKEA Family is a free membership program offered by IKEA that offers exclusive benefits including special discounts, invitations to events & workshops and personalized shopping experiences, All designed to enhance your home solutions and shopping experience.

2. Who can join the program?

The program is available to any individual residing in the Kingdom of Bahrain, provided they register using a valid mobile number or an active email address. Only one membership is permitted per person, and multiple accounts may not be opened for the same individual.

3. How can I register for the program?

You can join the program through:

• The official IKEA Bahrain website: www.ikea.com/bh/en

• Or via the IKEA smartphone app.

4. Will I receive a physical membership card?

No physical card is issued. After successful registration, a digital card will be activated and will appear in your registered account on the IKEA app or website. This card is personal and non-transferable.

5. Can the membership card be transferred to another person?

No, membership may not be transferred or used by any other party. The card and its associated privileges are for the registered member only.

6. What are the benefits of IKEA Family membership?

Benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Exclusive discounts on selected products.

• Invitations to events and workshops.

• Access to member-only offers and campaigns.

7. Do the discounts apply to all store products?

No. Discounts only apply to specific categories and products that are announced in advance and cannot be combined with other offers or discounts, unless explicitly stated otherwise.

8. How can I update my contact information or message preferences?

You can log in to your account via the IKEA website or IKEA app and update your contact information or preferences through your account settings.

9. What types of messages might I receive as a member?

As a member, you may receive messages via the following channels:

• SMS

• Email

• WhatsApp

These messages include information about offers, events, and promotions relevant to your interests and purchasing behavior.

10. Can I unsubscribe from promotional messages?

Yes, you can unsubscribe at any time by clicking the "Unsubscribe" link at the bottom of the messages, or through the communication settings in your account.

11. How is my personal data handled?

Your personal data is collected and processed in accordance with the data protection regulations in force in the Kingdom of Bahrain, and in accordance withIKEA's Privacy Policy

Your data is used for the following purposes:

• Activating and managing your membership.

• Personalizing content and offers

• Improving services and customer experience.

Your data is not shared with any third party except in accordance with strict legal controls or with your explicit consent.

12. Can my membership be suspended or cancelled?

Yes. IKEA reserves the right to suspend or cancel your membership in any of the following cases:

• Abuse of privileges.

• Committing any fraudulent activity.

• Breach of the program terms and conditions.

13. Can the program be modified or discontinued?

Yes, IKEA reserves the right to modify or terminate the IKEA Family program, in whole or in part, at any time.

If this happens, members will be notified as appropriate, and existing benefits will continue to apply until the changes become effective.

14. Is IKEA liable for any unauthorized use of my account?

IKEA is not liable for any damages or losses resulting from unauthorized use of a member's account. It is recommended that members keep their login information confidential and not share it with any third party.

15. Am I entitled to claim compensation in the event of a malfunction or interruption in the program?

No. IKEA is not legally or financially liable to members for any direct or indirect losses that may arise as a result of a technical malfunction, temporary or permanent interruption in the program, or any failure to provide benefits, whether for technical, organizational, or other reasons beyond the company's control.

16. Does IKEA guarantee continued provision of the same benefits throughout the membership period?

No. Benefits are granted based on internal company policy and are subject to change or cancellation without prior notice. The interruption of any benefit or offer shall not constitute a justification for any claim for compensation or liability.

17. What happens if I misuse the program without my knowledge?

The member is fully responsible for his or her behavior using the program, and claims of ignorance of the terms or lack of knowledge shall not be accepted. IKEA reserves the right to cancel membership immediately without prior notice and without incurring any liability.

18. Is IKEA liable for lost points or discounts due to account misuse?

No. The member is responsible for the correct use of the account, and IKEA is not liable for lost benefits or discounts due to user negligence or error, such as using outdated login credentials or forgetting the password.

19. Can I rely on the content of advertising messages as a legal obligation?

No. All marketing or advertising messages sent via email or text message are not a contractual obligation on the part of IKEA. You should always refer to the official terms and conditions published on the IKEA website for details and limitations of offers.

20. Does IKEA guarantee the security of electronic communications?

While IKEA is committed to securing its systems, it assumes no responsibility for any breach, data loss, or unauthorized access resulting from weak connections or customer devices. It is the member's responsibility to take the necessary security measures to protect their data.
